contentBlocks.body: Authentication proves who is making a request. Authorization asks whether that caller may act on this particular resource. The faulty function accepts every signed-in user. The regression must include a signed-in nonowner, since anonymous and owner-only tests would both pass and leave the access-control bug uncovered.

contentBlocks.code: export function canEdit(actor: string | null, owner: string): boolean { return actor !== null; }

**Check your understanding.** Why would a test using only the normal input fail to detect this defect? Write the reason in your own words before opening the solution. Run the additional cases as well as the visible example: the contract boundary 3 case checks a different boundary.
